name: com.fairynext.core
description: FairyGUI green-field rewrite runtime: SoA node tree + GPU-resident quad instance stream + push invalidation protocol. Pure C# (netstandard2.1), zero Unity dependencies in the runtime assemblies; imported into Unity as a local package (file:../../src). The Unity vertex-stream backend lives in the host project (unity/Assets/FairyNext). Property setters are generated at compile time by the bundled Roslyn analyzer (Core/Analyzers/FairyNext.PropGen.dll, label RoslynAnalyzer) — Core does not compile without it.
